attchmntText: IFCI Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: IFCI Limited approved the Un-audited Standalone and Consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, during its Board Meeting on November 12, 2026. Standalone revenue from operations was 136.72 Crore for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to 177.78 Crore in the same period last year. Standalone profit before tax was a loss of 3.4 Crore for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, versus a profit of 5.36 Crore in the prior year period. Consolidated revenue from operations stood at 733.04 Crore for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, against 732.28 Crore in the corresponding previous quarter. Consolidated profit before tax was 414.33 Crore for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to 381.47 Crore in the prior year period. The results are enclosed with respective Limited Review Reports.
